result.stdout:
raptor21-openapi [options] Generates a typed client from an OpenAPI document, restoring the generic response contracts the document carries as metadata instead of redefining them. Path or URL of the OpenAPI document. Options -o, --output C#: write to a file instead of standard output. TypeScript: a directory to write types.ts/client.ts/(queries.ts) into. -l, --language csharp (default) or typescript. --queries TypeScript only: also emit queries.ts with TanStack Query hooks. --body-name TypeScript only: name of the request-body parameter. Default: request. --optional-body TypeScript only: keep a body optional when the document does not mark it required (default treats every body as required — see README). -n, --namespace C# namespace for generated code. Default: GeneratedClient. --single-interface Emit one interface/client for the whole document instead of one per tag. --interface-name Name for that single interface/client. Implies --single-interface. --no-headers Leave every header parameter out of generated signatures. --skip-header Leave one header parameter out. Repeatable. --exclude-tag Skip every operation carrying this tag. Repeatable. --payload-property

Envelope property holding the payload. Default: data. --path-prefix Prepend this to every route, for a service reached through a gateway that mounts it under a prefix. --map = Map a projected contract type onto a local one. Repeatable. --using C#: extra using directive in the generated file. Repeatable. --di C#: also emit an extension method registering every interface as a Refit client. Needs Refit.HttpClientFactory in the target [truncated]
